relations.subject: G. U. Pope
relations.role: Professorship to teach Tamil and Telugu
relations.evidence: Pope returned to England in 1882, having lived in Tamil Nadu for approximately 42 years. He accepted a Professorship at Oxford University, to teach Tamil and Telugu.

relations.subject: G. U. Pope
relations.evidence: George Uglow Pope D.D. of South India sometime lecturer in tamil and telugu in the university and chaplain of balliol college, oxford

relations.subject: Selvakesavaraya Mudaliyar
relations.evidence: Professor Selvakesavaraya Mudaliyar, of the Tamil Department of Chennai Pachchayappan College, collected funds according to Pope's last wish and dispatched to London towards the headstone.
